required.name: Certificate III (or higher) in Mechanical Fitting (or equivalent)
required.hint: Certificate III/Cert III/Cert 3 in Mechanical Fitting or equivalent trade qualification

required.name: Minimum 2 years mechanical fitting experience
required.hint: 2+ years relevant maintenance, shutdowns, or projects

required.name: Site readiness: Standard 11 OR White Card (either acceptable)

positives.name: Current Coal Board Medical (or ability to obtain)
Adaptability across shutdowns/maintenance
positives.hint: flexible between short-term and long-term roles

red_flags.name: Candidate explicitly located outside Australia
red_flags.hint: If location clearly outside AU → red flag. If missing/unclear → Unknown.

notes.unknown_policy: If a required item is not clearly in the CV text, mark as Unknown (do not guess). If more than max_unknown_required are Unknown, verdict should lean 'Unsure – Needs Manual Review'.
notes.site_ready_tip: Mark 'site_ready' as met if EITHER Standard 11 OR White Card is present. If neither is stated, set Unknown.
